script.text: Yuya achieved his goal of becoming a pro duelist, but he had one more duel waiting for him.
Now now my son, your journey is only just beginning.
Yuya, becoming a pro dueltainer means embracing each new duel as a new challenge to overcome! Are you ready to take your dueltaining to the next level, son?
You bet! Dad, you sure did teach me a lot, but you didn't teach me everything!
It's time to swing into action!
